name: Anarchist's Cookbook
dropNote: Warlock Campaign Boss - Alpha guaranteed drop on first kill.

talent.name: Perfectly Wicked
talent.desc: Applying a status effect increases total weapon damage by 18% for 27s.

name: Axel
flavorText: "Don't fear your instincts, society taught you how to fail."

talent.name: Perfect Energize
talent.desc: (no tooltip text found)

name: Backbone
flavorText:
"Your first kill is hard. But it gets easier the more you do it."
- The Strategist

talent.name: Perfectly Unstoppable Force
talent.desc:
Killing an enemy increases total weapon damage by 7% for 15s. Stacks up to 5 times.
Grenade kills add 2 stacks.

talent.name: Perfectly Calculated
talent.desc: Kills from cover reduce skill cooldowns by 15%.

name: Bulldog
flavorText: No sweat.

talent.name: Perfect Composure
talent.desc: While in cover, increases total weapon damage by 20%.

name: Cap'n
flavorText: "Get behind me."

talent.name: Perfect Leadership
talent.desc:
Performing a cover to cover grants 20% of your armor as bonus armor to you and all allies for 10s.  

This is tripled if you end within 10m of an enemy.

Cooldown: 10s

talent.name: Perfect Clutch
talent.desc: Critical hits repair 20% missing armor while below 2.5% armor.

name: Festive Delivery
flavorText: "You get fireworks, and you get fireworks. Everybody gets fireworks!"

talent.name: Fireworks Show
talent.desc:
Concussion Grenades become Festive Grenades.

Hitting an enemy with a Festive Grenade will cause explosions to happen around two other enemies within 20m.

talent.name: Perfect Combined Arms
talent.desc: Shooting an enemy increases total skill damage by 30% for 300%s.

talent.name: Perfect Overclock
talent.desc: (no tooltip text found)

name: Lavoisier
flavorText: "A piece of perfection, if you understand what you can do with it." Anonymous

talent.name: Perfect Galvanize
talent.desc: Applying a Blind, Ensnare, Confuse, or Shock to an enemy grants 50% of your armor as bonus armor to you and all allies within 30m of that enemy for 10s.

name: Liquid Engineer
flavorText:
"Is that oil, or blood?"

- BTSU Combat Medic

talent.name: Perfect Bloodsucker
talent.desc: Killing an enemy adds a stack of +12% bonus armor for 10s. Max stack is 10.

name: Matador
flavorText:
"I used to dance with death itself, but grew tired of the performance. I think I prefer having the odds stacked against me instead."

- The Bull

talent.name: Perfect Adrenaline Rush
talent.desc:
Whenever you are within 10m of an enemy, gain 23% bonus armor for 5s.  Stacks up to 300% times. 

Cooldown: 5s

name: Momma Badger
flavorText: Not in my burrows.

talent.name: Perfect Safeguard
talent.desc: While at full armor, increases total skill repair by 160%.

name: Percussive Maintenance
flavorText: "Have you tried turning it off and on again?”

talent.name: Perfect Tech Support
talent.desc: Skill kills increase total skill damage by 25% for 27s.

name: Proxy
flavorText:
"Hostile detected. Hostile eliminated."
- Alexander Ortiz

talent.name: Perfectly Tamper Proof
talent.desc:
Enemies that walk within 300%m of your hive, turret, remote pulse or decoy are shocked.

Arm time: 200%s
Cooldown per skill: 8s

name: Strategic Alignment
flavorText: "I know this is going to look like we’re destroying everything. Don’t worry about it. We don’t make mistakes. Just happy accidents.”

talent.name: Perfect Shock and Awe
talent.desc: Applying a status effect to an enemy increases total skill damage and repair by 20% for 27s.

name: The Courier
flavorText: "May this carry your soul to paradise." The Priest

talent.name: Perfect Creeping Death
talent.desc: (no tooltip text found)

talent.desc: Increases total weapon damage by 25%. Taking damage disables this buff for 300%s.

talent.name: Perfectly Opportunistic
talent.desc: Enemies you hit take 15% more damage from all sources for 5s.

name: Vigil
flavorText: “Honor the fallen.”

talent.name: Perfect Versatile
talent.desc:
Amplifies total weapon damage for 10s when swapping between your primary and secondary weapons if they are different.

45% to enemies within 15m for Shotguns and SMGs.

40% to enemies further than 25m for Rifles and Marksman Rifles.

15% to enemies between 15-25m for LMGs and Assault Rifles.

At most once per 5s per weapon type.

name: Benefactor
flavorText: I can assure you we can all benefit from this.

talent.name: Perfect Empathic Resolve
talent.desc:
Repairing an ally increases their total weapon and skill damage by 3%-20% for 20s.  1%-15% if self.

Effectiveness increased by your skill tier.

name: Bober
flavorText:
"No way they can get me in this."
- Diesel

talent.name: Perfect Entrench
talent.desc:
If you are below 30% armor, headshots from cover repair 30% of your armor.

Cooldown: 100%s

talent.name: Perfectly Skilled
talent.desc: Skill kills have a 30% chance to reset skill cooldowns.

name: Carpenter
flavorText:
"The things I break stay broken."
- The Strategist

talent.name: Perfectly Mad Bomber
talent.desc:
Grenade radius is increased by +75%.  

Grenades that kill an enemy are refunded.

Grenades can now be "cooked" by holding the fire button, making them explode earlier.
 
Gain +15% bonus armor while aiming grenades.

name: Chainkiller
flavorText:
"Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall, ninety-nine bottles of beer. Shoot one down, watch it explode, ninety-eight bottles of beer on the wall..."

- Bored True Sons marksman

talent.name: Perfect Headhunter
talent.desc: (no tooltip text found)

talent.name: Perfect Spotter
talent.desc: Amplifies total weapon and skill damage by 20% to pulsed enemies.

name: Combustor
flavorText:
"My operatives would never be left alone in the field."
- Natalya Sokolova

talent.name: Perfectly Explosive Delivery
talent.desc:
Whenever you throw a skill, 150% seconds after landing, it creates an explosion damaging enemies within 5m.
Afterwards, explosions will occur every 5s.

Damage scales with skill tier dealing 25%-100% damage of a concussion grenade.

talent.name: Perfect Spark
talent.desc: Damaging enemies with a skill increases total weapon damage by 18% for 20s.

name: Equalizer
flavorText: Building them up to bring them down,

talent.name: Perfect Obliterate
talent.desc: Critical hits increase total weapon damage by 1% for 10s. Stacks up to 24 times.

name: Everyday Carrier
flavorText:
"What's in my everyday carry? As many armor plates as I can fit."

- Agent Sanders

talent.name: Perfectly Efficient
talent.desc:
Using an armor kit has a 75% chance to not consume the armor kit.

Specialization armor kit bonuses are increased by 100%.

Requires 10 seconds to arm talent

name: Ferocious Calm
flavorText: "The invention of the gun required a redefinition of courage from aggressive ferocity to calmness under fire.” - Robert L. O’Connell

talent.name: Perfect Overwatch
talent.desc: (no tooltip text found)

name: Henri
flavorText: "We live together, we learn together, we die together. But, first we make each other stronger." Anonymous

talent.name: Perfect Companion
talent.desc: While you are within 10m of an ally or skill, total weapon damage is increased by 20%

name: Hunter-Killer
dropNote: Unique reward from the Haven "ivory key" box for killing all the Warlock Hunters.

talent.name: Perfect Intimidate
talent.desc:
While you have bonus armor, gain 1 stack each second up to a max of 10. Each stack increases weapon damage by 4% to enemies within 10m.

All stacks are lost when you have no bonus armor.

name: Impetus
flavorText: "Don't stop, can't stop, won't stop."

talent.name: Perfect Kinetic Momentum
talent.desc:
When in combat, each skill generates a stack while active or not on cooldown.

Stacks increase your total skill damage by 1.5% and total skill repair by 2%. Up to 18 stacks per skill. Lost when on cooldown.

name: Pointman
dropNote: Warlock Campaign Boss - Charlie guaranteed drop on first kill.

talent.name: Perfect Vanguard
talent.desc:
Deploying a shield makes it invulnerable for 5s and grants 50% of your armor as bonus armor to all other allies for 20s.  

Cooldown: 25s

name: Pristine Example
flavorText: “Only the first shot is clean. Everything after that is just messy.”

talent.name: Perfect Focus
talent.desc: Increases total weapon damage by 6% every second you are aiming while scoped 8x or higher, up to 60%.

name: Robin
flavorText: I paid for all the guns so I'm going to use all of the guns.

talent.name: Perfect Gunslinger
talent.desc: Weapon swapping increases total weapon damage by 28% for 5s.  This buff is lost for 5s if you weapon swap while it is active.

name: Sleight
flavorText: "I'm feeling generous."

talent.name: Perfect Protected Reload
talent.desc: Grants +40% bonus armor while reloading. Grants 0%-30% of your armor as bonus armor to all other allies when they are reloading, based on your core attribute.

name: The Sacrifice
flavorText: “Only after everything has been given, can you expect to receive. When the vessel is empty, the soul is complete.”

talent.name: Perfect Glass Cannon
talent.desc: All damage you deal is amplified by 30%.  All damage you take is amplified by 60%.

name: Zero F’s
flavorText: "Here is the field where I grow my Fs, lo it lies fallow."

talent.name: Perfectly Unbreakable
talent.desc:
When your armor is depleted, repair 100% of your armor. 

Cooldown: 55s

name: Contractor's Gloves
flavorText: “Never met a man I couldn’t break. Apply enough pressure on a small enough point, and anything cracks.”

name: Deathgrips
flavorText: “Most people are white-knuckling their way through life, stress levels off the charts. Working dead-end jobs, paying off their loans, student debts, fucking lattes. That shit will kill you without clarity in your life. And nothing brings clarity like hanging off the side of a mountain.”

name: Eagle's Grasp
flavorText:
"Just wait until I get my hands on them."
- Saint

name: Firm Handshake
flavorText: “You can tell a lot about a person from their handshake. It’s also a great pathogenic delivery system.”

name: Ammo Dump
flavorText:
"Whaddya mean yer outta ammo? Dig around in that mess you call a holster and find something to shove in your gun and shoot!"
- True Sons platoon leader

name: Claws Out
flavorText: "Rip and Tear"

name: Forge
flavorText: "The space between is where you want to be. Not the hammer. Not the anvil. You are the impact; the energy. The potential. Bend or break, you will find purpose. And in purpose, there is truth.”

name: Salvo
flavorText: Gone in a flash.

name: Spot-on
flavorText: "It's all in the hip."

name: Cloak
flavorText: "No sudden movements."

name: Emperors Guard
flavorText: "Fall down seven times, get up eight"

name: Fox's Prayer
flavorText: “Ever heard of an atheist in a foxhole? Me neither.”
fixedAttributes: Damage to Targets Out of Cover

name: Grease
flavorText: "I'm not in danger. I am the danger."

name: Snowmaker
flavorText: "Like our friends down under, if we want Snow on Christmas we have to make it ourselves."

talent.name: Flurry
talent.desc: Every Status Effect you apply will also apply snowfall to the target.

name: Turmoil
flavorText: Never let them know your next move.

talent.name: Bewildered
talent.desc:
When dealing Weapon Damage to an enemy, 50% of the damage will be dealt to another enemy within 30m instead. When there are no enemies nearby, deal damage normally.
Does not apply to Armor Plates.

name: Chill Out
flavorText:
"Revenge is a dish best served cold."
- Someone who remembers you

name: Nightwatcher
flavorText: “Through glass and steel; looking at you; a view so cruel.”

name: Punch Drunk
flavorText: “If the first shot doesn’t drop ‘em, the second one will. Or the third. Third’s usually good.”

name: The Hollow Man
flavorText: “No whimper. No bang. Just silence. The end of all things.”

name: Visionario
flavorText:
“So far be distant; and good night, sweet friend."
- A Midsummer Night’s Dream
